context_policy: The SEC facts APIs publish facts without dimensional qualifiers, so every row in this capture is a fact with no dimensions. They do not publish the filing's contextRef, so each row's context is pinned by (accession, element, period, unit) with no dimensions, which identifies exactly one fact in that filing.

elements.description: The net result for the period of deducting operating expenses from operating revenues.
elements.label: Operating Income (Loss)

normalisation.basis: the filed amounts are already in the unit the capture holds
